title: EvoScene-VLA: Evolving Scene Beliefs Inside the Action Decoder for Chunked Robot Control
abstract: arXiv:2605.21862v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Chunked vision-language-action (VLA) policies predict multi-step robot controls, conditioning each update on the current visual observation alone. Yet robot actions cause contact, occlusion, and object motion, and the geometry that later decisions depend on can change before the next visual update arrives. Spatial VLAs improve current-frame geometry. Temporal VLAs aggregate past frames. Neither maintains an action-updated scene prior across chunks. We argue for a persistent action-updated scene state across control calls, and introduce EvoScene-VLA. Its recurrent scene prefix carries a geometry-aware scene state across chunks. At each vision-language model (VLM) call, the VLM combines scene information from the current observation with the action-updated prior from the previous chunk; the action decoder outputs both the next action chunk and a compact scene update. translated_title: EvoScene-VLA：在动作解码器内演化场景信念以实现分块机器人控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.21862v2 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：分块视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略预测多步机器人控制，每次更新仅基于当前视觉观察。然而，机器人动作会引起接触、遮挡和物体运动，后续决策所依赖的几何结构可能在下一个视觉更新到来之前发生变化。空间VLA改进当前帧的几何信息，时间VLA聚合过去帧信息，但两者都不维护跨分块的动作更新场景先验。我们主张在控制调用之间保持持久、动作更新的场景状态，并引入EvoScene-VLA。其循环场景前缀跨分块携带几何感知的场景状态。在每次视觉-语言模型（VLM）调用时，VLM将当前观察中的场景信息与来自前一分块的动作更新先验相结合；动作解码器输出下一动作分块和紧凑的场景更新。该更新成为下一个先验，VLM随后再次纠正。
tldr: 本文提出EvoScene-VLA，通过引入跨分块的持久动作更新场景状态，使视觉-语言-动作模型在控制决策中保持几何感知，从而提升机器人控制的连贯性和准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EvoScene-VLA, which maintains a persistent action-updated scene state across chunks, enabling vision-language-action models to preserve geometric awareness during control decisions, thereby improving coherence and accuracy in robot control.
